trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn every other trophy; this route is reported, not yet checked in the game. Output Lag reports no mission replay or New Game Plus at launch, 15 manual slots plus one autosave, and cheats disabling trophies and saving: keep a manual save at each chapter start, an untouched save before the final mission, and never use cheats on this save. Only Positive Mental Attitude is reported missable; save before the hourglass-marked Chapter 3 Race Against Yago and do it immediately for Strangers & Freaks. The reported platinum estimate is around 200 hours, so preserve those saves throughout cleanup.

trophies.guide: This is the only reported missable trophy, not yet checked in the game: seek nearby purple icons for the 18-count target and bring your partner, because outdoor spots reportedly count twice when both characters meditate.
